[[File:Cave crawler icon.png|left]]
'''Cave crawlers''' are [[Slayer]] monsters that require level 10 Slayer to kill. They drop a variety of [[Herblore]] related items and seeds. They are poisonous and have a fast healing rate (approximately 10 life points per second). [[Cave crawler (Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon)|Level 59 cave crawlers]] have a much higher chance of dropping herbs and seeds than the level 24.

Cave crawlers are a popular delicacy amongst the [[Dorgeshuun]] [[cave goblin]]s, who cut them into [[fillets]] and serve them on a large platter.

In the quest [[Fur 'n Seek]], a [[cave crawler skin]] must be collected and cleaned for the [[Odd Old Man]].

==Strengths and weaknesses==
Level 24 crawlers, compared to other similarly-levelled monsters, are relatively weak and should only require a few mid-level food such as [[swordfish]] or [[beltfish]] with a high enough [[Defence]] level and if an [[antipoison]] is consumed immediately upon being poisoned. The level 59 crawlers are a tougher challenge and will likely require additional food or healing methods. Cave crawlers are great temporary training for mid-to high-level [[melee]] players. Due to their fairly low defence, tier 50 gear and level 60 combat stats will suffice for [[Slayer]] tasks or training.

Cave crawlers poison fairly often with their ranged attacks so it is advised to bring [[antipoison]] when fighting them, or prevent being poisoned (for some time) using a [[super antipoison]], the [[anti-poison totem]], or using the Oo'glog [[thermal bath]] prior to engaging in combat. Their poison is not much of a threat at higher levels, and can be offset with good food or healing abilities. However, lower level players are suggested to bring at least one method of poison mitigation, as it can be deadly if not paid attention to. Due to their high accuracy, complete mitigation of damage at lower levels is unlikely.
